instruction: Run `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\osc.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\osc.out`, `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\osc_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\osc.dat`. The native sweep tests five candidate feedback capacitors. From `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\osc_measure.txt`, choose the smallest `C_FB` whose overshoot is at most `10%`, where `overshoot_pct = (|Vmin| - |Vfinal|) / |Vfinal| * 100`. Then write `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\stabilize.json` with `best_C_FB_pF`, `Vfinal_V`, `Vmin_V`, `overshoot_pct`, `meets_10pct_overshoot`, and `n_candidates`.
